# NumSys — Number System Converter

> Free browser-based converter for binary, octal, decimal, hexadecimal and base 2–36,
> plus Indian (lakh, crore, arab, kharab, neel, padma, shankh) and International
> (thousand, million, billion, trillion, quadrillion) number naming.
> Every conversion shows the working; everything runs client-side and no input is transmitted.

## Core tools

- [Number System Converter](https://numbersystemconverter.com/): Base 2–36 converter with positional expansion and repeated division, plus an Indian ⇄ International naming converter. Default example: 156₁₀ = 10011100₂.
- [Base Converter Calculator](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/base-converter-calculator/): Any radix from 2 to 36, fractions included. A base converter calculator rewrites one value in a different radix: digits 0–1 (base 2), 0–7 (base 8), 0–9 (base 10), 0–9 plus A–F (base 16), up to 0–9 plus A–Z (base 36).
- [Converter With Steps](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-converter-with-steps/): Worked step-by-step conversion. 156₁₀ → 10011100₂ in eight divisions; 10011100₂ → 156 by adding 128 + 16 + 8 + 4.
- [Calculator With Solution](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-calculator-with-solution/): Full solution format: positional weights, division chain, fractional carries and a reverse check. Example: 200₁₀ = 11001000₂; 0.6875₁₀ = 0.1011₂.
- [Conversion Table](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-table/): 0–255 in decimal, 8-bit binary, 3-digit octal and 2-digit hexadecimal, plus powers of two and Indian vs International scales.
- [Conversion PDF](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/number-system-conversion-pdf/): Free two-page printable chart (23 KB). Direct file: https://numbersystemconverter.com/number-system-conversion-table.pdf

## Reference

- [Knowledge Catalog](https://numbersystemconverter.com/knowledge-catalog/): Directory of all six guides, use cases, audience and FAQ.
- [About](https://numbersystemconverter.com/about/): What the site does, how examples are checked, and the editorial team.

## Key facts

- 1 million = 10 lakh; 1 billion = 1 arab = 100 crore; 1 trillion = 1 lakh crore.
- Indian scale: lakh 10^5, crore 10^7, arab 10^9, kharab 10^11, neel 10^13, padma 10^15, shankh 10^17.
- International short scale: million 10^6, billion 10^9, trillion 10^12, quadrillion 10^15.
- Portuguese (Portugal) uses the long scale: bilião = 10^12. Brazilian Portuguese uses the short scale: bilhão = 10^9.
- Spanish billón = 10^12; English billion = mil millones = 10^9.
- French milliard, German Milliarde, Dutch miljard, Italian miliardo = 10^9.
- Japanese, Chinese and Korean group in fours: 万 = 10^4, 億 = 10^8, 兆 = 10^12.
- 255 = 11111111 (binary) = 377 (octal) = FF (hex).
- 156 = 10011100 (binary) = 234 (octal) = 9C (hex).
- Base conversion rule: sum digit × base^position to reach decimal; divide repeatedly and read remainders bottom-to-top to leave decimal.
